reason: A DSH interface plugin that provides a floating right-side panel for browsing, previewing, and jumping between turns in long conversations, including automatically loaded older history.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 聊天窗口提供右侧悬浮的会话轮次导航，可预览问题摘要并快速跳转到历史轮次。
summaries.en: Adds a floating right-side navigation panel to DSH conversations for previewing question summaries and jumping between historical turns.

capabilities: Adds a floating right-side conversation-turn navigation panel
Reads rendered conversation nodes to display question summaries
Automatically loads older conversation pages through DSH session APIs
Observes chat DOM changes and scroll position to refresh and highlight navigation
